anchor.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: FC House Style exploration anchor board
Primary request: Create one square 2x2 anchor board showing four independent fantasy subjects rendered by the same illustrator in exactly the same visual language.
Scene/backdrop and subjects: top-left panel — one adult medieval woman warrior standing in a village courtyard; top-right panel — one adult brown bear standing in a forest clearing; bottom-left panel — one four-legged, two-winged dragon standing on a rocky upland; bottom-right panel — one small medieval village containing modest houses, a central well, and a watchtower.
Style/medium: Hand-colored fantasy woodcut print: strongly carved black-brown contour shapes, broad flat negative spaces, controlled parallel hatching only for major shadow planes, simplified angular anatomy, and translucent hand-applied color washes that sit imperfectly inside the cuts on warm paper. Bold, historic, and readable; no smooth gradients, no photorealism, no digital gloss.
Composition/framing: square canvas divided into four equal square panels with clean, even gutters and no labels; each subject centered, complete, safely framed, and immediately readable; keep the warrior full-body and the bear and dragon fully inside their panels, including every paw, claw, wing tip, tail tip, and horn.
Lighting/mood: neutral diffuse daylight; grounded and observational, neither grim nor celebratory.
Color palette: natural local colors appropriate to each subject and scene; restrained translucent washes on warm paper; do not impose one dramatic color cast.
Constraints: exactly four panels and exactly the four requested subjects; consistent artist, print process, contour carving, hatching density, shape simplification, and color-wash handling in every panel; anatomically plausible adult warrior, bear with four legs and normal paw anatomy, dragon with exactly four legs and exactly two wings; no fire, magic effects, dramatic sky, rim light, text, labels, logo, watermark, or ornate border; no extra focal subjects.

qa.notes: All four panels share black-brown carved contours, warm paper, restrained color washes, angular simplification, and consistent engraving-like material handling.
